_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. The six districts of Planet 1 in play order (spec section 1). rings: size, 1 + 3r(r+1) hexes. The cities are larger than the spec's first sizes (rings 6 to 16) because a crew of 100 to 200 robots needs the ground: 127, 271, 469, 817, 1261 and 2107 hexes, about 3% of the planet. pollution: the kinds its hexes hold; mix: each kind's share of one hex's work. buried_parts_per_hex: buried parts each cleaned hex leaves for the Scroungers to dig up (district 1 has none: there Parts come only from Lumi's own hands). hex_work: units of work to clean one hex (it rises by district so that cleaning power can double every 30-40 minutes while hexes a minute rise far less; see docs/reviews/BALANCE_PROPOSAL_P1.md). source: reach_s (walk in), clear_hexes (hexes' worth of work only Lumi can clear round it), action_s (the hands-on action), trickle_hexes_per_min and trickle_cap_hexes (new waste it adds to that job until it is shut), payout (Parts and field data only: cubes come from bales and stage payouts), grants (ids owned from then on: a rig slot, a tool, a module). arrival_s: the first hop to the district. target: player minutes in the district from spec section 12, the crew the base can hold by then (section 14: a handful, tens, 100 to 200) and the least hand share of cleaning volume the district must keep (10% before district 4); the report compares against it. District ids 3-6 and source ids 3-6 are working names for the lead to replace. Top level: hex_bonus = paid when a hex is clean, whoever cleaned it: cubes_per_work x the district's hex_work in cubes, and `data` field data; stage_reward_ref_work = the regrowth.json rewards are multiplied by the district's hex_work over this, so regrowth pays in step with the work a hex took; stage_share = share of hexes that sets the district stage; source_available_stage = district stage at which the source job opens; source_caps_stage = hexes cannot pass this stage until the source is shut; hop_s = a later hop from the map.
